added_failure_source: measured by this review: logs/gate-base-flight.log (base arm, EXIT=0) and logs/gate-head-flight.log (head arm, EXIT=1), both in this review run's directory; the reviewed run armed no suite pair, so no baseline_suite/after_suite was available to derive from

findings.text: blocking: the generated model is hand-edited and its LinkML source reckon/schema/flight.yaml was not, so tests/test_flight.py::test_committed_pydantic_model_matches_linkml_source passes at base 5adc9f1c5b and fails at head f743b68f74 (logs/gate-base-flight.log 2 passed EXIT=0 against logs/gate-head-flight.log 1 failed EXIT=1); docs/_shared/flight.schema.json and reckon/schema/flight-defaults.yaml, both declared write paths, still carry no stranded_wait, so the published schema rejects the setting and the next regeneration erases StrandedWaitConfig.

non-blocking: recent_upstream_retirements returns only the newest verdict-log record's retired list, and every later pass writes a record whose retired list is empty, so the wait-retired-upstream duty disappears before its owner reads it whenever any pass records a verdict or a landing in between.

non-blocking: assert pass_record["retired"] == outcome["retired"] compares the record against the very list the test passed into _pass_verdict_record, so it holds whatever the function does with the value; the adjacent `is not None` on line 161 is the assertion that guards the product change.

item_verdicts.diff: read all three commits against 5adc9f1c5b: the classification, its stamps, the retirement and idle-report paths, the obligations duties, the test file and the evidence fragment land inside the declared scope, except that reckon/_flight_schema.py is a generated file edited in place of its source.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_wait_that_cannot_resolve_is_removed.py; its eight cases cover the 500-hour progressing wait, the superseded-plan retirement with its reason, the absent-section retirement, the idle report once, the held stranded request and the lost owner's retirement, and the manifest records 8 passed EXIT=0 in gate.log and gate-final.log.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to class every awaiting-upstream request by what could release it; reckon/crew/stranded_wait.py:76-103 defines progressing, idle and stranded from the pass's own per-ref states and reckon/crew/admission/release.py:247-270 stamps wait_class and wait_detail on the request.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits a9b62cfb00, 07f33a806e and f743b68f74, the gate command it ran, 8 passed at both heads, the neighbour failure proven identical over an extracted base tree, the declared control's red log, and rubric lines for all six dimensions.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are the fragment, a figure directory, eight reckon modules and the test, plus docs/_shared/flight.schema.json, reckon/schema/flight.yaml and reckon/schema/flight-defaults.yaml; the diff touches ten files, all inside the declared set, but the three flight-schema paths were left unedited while the generated reckon/_flight_schema.py was written by hand.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_wait_that_cannot_resolve_is_removed.py:196-205 fails if a second pass rebuilds the retired request or records a second retirement, while line 162 compares the pass record against the same list passed into it.
justifications.evidence: gate.log reads 8 passed EXIT=0 at 07f33a806e and gate-final.log the same at f743b68f74, and negative-control.log is a genuine red at 5adc9f1c5b, yet the gate set never ran tests/test_flight.py, which the change turns red.
justifications.fit: reckon/_flight_schema.py:1 states the file is generated from reckon/schema/flight.yaml and must not be edited, and the change edits it directly.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/admission/release.py:661-676 retires a stranded wait, 681-688 reports an idle one once and 717-736 leaves a held request alone, so all three classes act as the goal states, though the threshold the idle class reads is not declarable through the schema source.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/stranded_wait.py:105-134 reuses _wait_refs._docs_for_project and _section_status on the states the readiness module already resolves, and the neighbouring wait-unresolvable duty at reckon/crew/obligations.py:371 covers a different case (a ref naming a run no project holds).
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the declared set, but reckon/schema/flight.yaml and its two siblings were declared write paths left untouched while reckon/_flight_schema.py:228 was edited by hand.
